promptLines: Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: individual Palari V2 character study

Primary request: Create one original Palari. Palari means Personal Artificial Intelligence. A Palari is a small crafted ceramic vessel whose single colored interior reveals its unique intelligence. This character belongs to a coherent species, not a human, conventional robot, toy wearing clothes, or household vessel.
Selected design:
- identity: deep charcoal hood arch with crossed arms around a teal slit
- silhouette: protective enclosing arch formed from one continuous ceramic shell
- crown: protective soft hood grown from the ceramic body
- opening: one long narrow recessed channel centered in the enclosing arch
- pose: both rounded arms crossed calmly around the opening
- expression: serene
- exterior material: near-black charcoal ceramic with broad readable highlights and visible microtexture
- characteristic color: deep ceramic teal (#146B68)
Family invariants:
- exactly one complete isolated figure with a stable continuous ceramic base
- tactile fine stoneware exterior with matte-to-satin glaze and subtle handmade microtexture
- exactly one characteristic hue: deep ceramic teal only, limited to the recessed inner intelligence, iris accents, and Palari seed mark; no other colored hue
- exactly one dominant architecturally intentional narrow channel and no unrelated holes
- exactly two calm half-lidded inset eyes with ceramic eyelids, dark pupils, teal iris accents, and tiny catchlights
- exactly two curved tubular ceramic arms ending in perfectly smooth seamless rounded tips with no hand anatomy; cross them calmly around the narrow channel
- no conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, or visible human anatomy
- one compact six-aperture Palari seed mark on the lower front: four larger circular apertures at the corners of a compact rectangle plus exactly two smaller apertures centered vertically
- clean intact ceramic with smooth deliberately finished edges
- overall body height at least 2.4 times visible face height
Scene: warm minimalist plaster alcove studio with a matte limestone floor.
Composition: eye-level three-quarter product portrait with minimal lens distortion; direct 1:1 square, full figure visible and centered, occupying about 76 percent of image height.
Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper left with a gentle contact shadow. Preserve broad readable highlights on charcoal ceramic and inner depth without neon glow.

Avoid: simple horizontal bowl or cup rim, fingers, thumbs, palms, fingernails, realistic hands, conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, human skin, hair, clothing, jewelry, demographic costume shorthand, multiple characteristic colors, rainbow effects, neon glow, robot joints, screens, wires, exposed machinery, appliance details, random holes, more than one dominant opening, cracks, chips, broken rims, dirt, antique distressing, cups, mugs, vases, planters, lamps, speakers, household appliances, generic mascot smiles, chibi proportions, horror, vacant doll eyes, circular aperture surrounding the face, text, labels, numbers, logos, watermarks, duplicated characters.
prompts.resultReview: Strong selected charcoal hood-arch, single teal channel, two calm eyes, crossed fingerless arms, legless base, palette, and studio framing; seed has five apertures.

Replace only that mark with exactly six teal circular apertures: four larger apertures at the four corners of a compact upright rectangle plus exactly two smaller apertures centered vertically between the left and right columns.

promptLines: Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: square Palari mascot logo icon

Input image: Image 1 is an identity reference only, not an edit target. Derive a new symbol from its enclosing hood-arch shell, narrow aperture, eyes, crossed arms, and seed family detail. Do not copy its alcove, lighting, charcoal material realism, camera scene, or shadow.

Primary request: Create one highly simplified IP mascot logo candidate, not a character illustration, for this exact Palari: a protective hooded arch enclosing one long teal slit, with two calm half-lidded eyes, two thick rounded arms crossed around the opening, and a compact seed detail. The enclosing shell-and-aperture silhouette plus the crossed arms are the primary identity; the seed is secondary.
Background: fully opaque edge-to-edge uniform solid deep navy #172333, used only for the background.

Subject colors: exactly warm ivory #E9E6DF for the shell, hood, arms, and eyelids; exactly deep ceramic teal #146B68 for the single continuous aperture region, two minimal eye marks, and the six-aperture seed family detail. No other semantic colors.
Composition: upright mark emerging from the lower-right corner, filling 75–85% of the square. Preserve both crossed rounded arms and the protective arch identity. Square outer corners.

Complexity: approximately 6–10 broad rounded semantic shapes; one dominant continuous outer silhouette; one large continuous teal inner region; only two simple half-lidded eyes and no mouth. Keep the exact six seed apertures tiny and subordinate, grouped as four larger corner circles plus two smaller circles centered vertically.

Style: flat-first vector-friendly geometry with thick rounded weighty contours. Use only one uninterrupted, extremely subtle low-frequency same-family diffuse gradient inside each large IP color region, sharing an upper-left-to-lower-right direction; transition spans at least half the form; total lightness variation at most 0.08; micro-volume visible only at full size and disappearing at 32 × 32.
Small-size requirement: at 32 × 32, the hooded arch, teal slit, and crossed-arm silhouette must remain immediately readable; the seed may compress but must not become the main logo.

Forbid: source scene, plaster alcove, floor, realistic ceramic, texture, gloss, bevel, extrusion, strong 3D, clay toy rendering, cast shadow, contact shadow, highlight patches, closed shadow shapes, halo, vignette, background gradient, border, frame, App-icon mask, rounded canvas corners, transparency, text, watermark, mouth, eyebrows, nose, fingers, hands, legs, feet, clothing, machinery, extra openings, extra colors, decorative marks, thin lines, sharp points, centered sticker composition.
prompts.resultReview: The hood, teal channel, eyes, and crossed arms are clear, but the mark is centered, the seed count is five, and the navy field is vignetted.

promptLines: Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: corrected square Palari mascot logo icon
Input images: Image 1 is the original identity reference; Image 2 is the logo candidate edit target.

Primary request: Correct only three rule failures in Image 2 while preserving its exact simplified hooded arch, long teal slit, two half-lidded eyes, both thick crossed arms, ivory/teal palette, flat-first geometry, and no-mouth expression.
1. Replace the visible navy vignette/gradient with a perfectly uniform, fully opaque, edge-to-edge solid #172333 field. No lighting variation, halo, or texture in the background.
2. Recompose the intact upright mark so it clearly emerges from the lower-right corner and fills 75–85% of the square, without cropping either crossed arm or the hood.

3. Replace the five-dot seed with exactly six deep-teal #146B68 circles: four larger corner circles of a compact upright rectangle plus exactly two smaller circles on one centered vertical line between those columns.

Constraints: retain exactly three semantic colors total: #172333 only for background, #E9E6DF for the ivory shell/arms/eyelids, and #146B68 for the aperture/eye region/seed. Keep the source identity led by shell plus aperture and crossed arms. No new details. No scene, realistic material, texture, gloss, bevel, strong 3D, cast shadow, mouth, human anatomy, thin lines, border, transparency, rounded canvas corners, text, or watermark.
prompts.resultReview: The seed count improved to six, but the mark remained centered and the background retained a visible vignette.

The mark remains horizontally centered and cropped along the full bottom edge rather than emerging specifically from the lower-right.
The six seed circles form two vertical columns with the two smaller circles side-by-side in the middle row, rather than two small circles on one centered vertical line.
Ivory and teal regions drift numerically from the requested hex bases and retain slightly stronger tonal modeling than strict micro-volume.
The literal geometry exceeds the nominal 6–10 shape budget once eyes, crossed arms, aperture, and six seed circles are counted separately.
